text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Ines Fujin engaged in<n>some lively
conversation with her<n>friends.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep, I recommend starting off with<n>sales or
catering! This magazine here<n>lists a bunch of open
positions...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, there are so many! Are there<n>any that catch
your eye, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. They all look rather inviting, but<n>it's a little
difficult to envision what<n>the role entails from the
description<n>alone...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Howdy, howdy! These<n>two were asking
me for advice on<n>part-time jobs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I figured a part-time job would<n>make for
some sweet work<n>experience! That's why I was
asking<n>Ines what kind of jobs are out there.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So, getting back on topic, I<n>recommend a position at
a<n>convenience shop or as a delivery<n>driver—a
lotta-lot of those places are<n>eager to hire
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense—plus you could get<n>a sweet
workout carrying stuff<n>around!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I see... So, what exactly would thisjob involve, then?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You put on a mascot costume for that<n>one. And you
get to play with kids! I<n>had so much fun doing that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And that's not the only fun<n>experience I've had. I
helped out with<n>a magic show once, and did some
live<n>picture book readings, too. So many<n>memories!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What else... Oh, there was that one<n>time I helped
excavate some ruins.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ruins?! Wait, do part-time jobs likethat actually exist?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Only if you know where to look—they<n>don't usually
advertise in magazines<n>like these! Oh, another job
you can<n>get is selling lunch boxes at a<n>baseball
stadium—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A b-baseball stadium?! They have<n>part-time jobs at
baseball stadiums?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Man, this is wild. ...I mean, it's pretty<n>amazing that
there are so many<n>different job openings crammed
into<n>this one magazine, sure...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But what's really remarkable is that<n>you seem to
have tried almost all of<n>them, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, well, when it comes to<n>part-time jobs, I've
gotcha covered!<n>Anyway... Hm?

Ines Fujin turns her gaze to a<n>passing
Umamusume who's glancing<n>off to the side while
carrying a tray<n>piled high with desserts.

Just as the peril of the situation is<n>beginning to
dawn on me, her foot<n>slips, and—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Watch out!

Everyone winces, anticipating the<n>inevitable mess
of ruined pastries on<n>the ground. ...However.
Swoosh!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Good thing I caught all those<n>desserts!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
When you're holding a tray, try<n>stabilizing it with
your fingers instead<n>of your palms! Oh, and try not
to get<n>distracted!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you so much... I'm so sorry<n>about this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: How did you do that?! You wentwhoosh through the air and caughtevery single dessert!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'd done that before at a part-time<n>gig!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That doesn't explain anything!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Well, I wasn't working as a<n>ninja or
anything—it's just a hack I<n>picked up from a diner
job.

Ines Fujin laughs off her incredible<n>feat, but it looks
like her long work<n>history is paying off in various
ways.
choice_data_list: It's like there's nothing you can't do.
It's like there's nothing you can't do.

text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin laughs off her incredible<n>feat, but it looks
like her long work<n>history is paying off in various
ways.
choice_data_list: It's like there's nothing you can't do.
It's like there's nothing you can't do.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I guess. ♪ But I'm just getting<n>started. I mean,
there are still so<n>many professions out there for me
to<n>try!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
There are tuna shoal experts, people<n>who research
soil to make the best<n>rice, artists who can make
stunning<n>pictures using just a few colored<n>pencils...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Seeing pros like those makes me<n>realize there's a
lot I can't do! It's a<n>big world out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know whether you're really<n>overambitious
or I'm just massively<n>lacking in work experience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I believe we've somehow<n>transitioned from
part-time work to<n>full-fledged vocations...

While I suspect her scope is a little<n>overblown, I'm
reminded of just how<n>talented Ines Fujin really is.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks for the compliment! You<n>know, I do all
this because I want to,<n>so it's kinda weird hearing
you say<n>that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But now I really want to focus on<n>striking a good
balance between my<n>training and my work!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. I wonder if all that part-time<n>work is the
secret to Ines's strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This all goes to show just how<n>beneficial part-time
jobs are!
I feel like these two are missing the<n>point a little...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer! I'm counting on you<n>to keep
supporting me! ♪ I mean, I do<n>rely on you.

I come away from the experience<n>feeling like Ines
Fujin and I really do<n>have a strong bond.
